user.title: Connect to Grocy
user.description: Enter the URL of your Grocy instance and an API key (Grocy → Manage API keys).

data_description.url: Base URL of Grocy as reachable from Home Assistant. Grocy add-on: {url_example} (a network port must be set in the add-on configuration).
data_description.verify_ssl: Verify the SSL certificate (only relevant for https)

data_description.expiry_days: Products whose best-before date is within this many days are reported.
data_description.notify_service: Service used for expiry notifications, e.g. notify.mobile_app_phone.
data_description.todo_entity: Products below minimum stock are added here (e.g. a Bring! list).
data_description.ai_task_entity: Used to read best-before dates from photos. Leave empty to use the default AI Task entity.
data_description.external_barcode_lookup: When booking a purchase with an unknown barcode, Grocy looks it up on Open Food Facts (free, only the barcode is sent) and creates the product automatically.

add_stock.name: Add stock
add_stock.description: Books a purchase in Grocy (stock +amount) by barcode or product ID.

barcode.name: Barcode
barcode.description: Barcode of the product (EAN/GTIN or a Grocy barcode). Use either barcode or product ID.

product_id.name: Product ID
product_id.description: Grocy product ID. Use either barcode or product ID.

amount.name: Amount
amount.description: Amount in the product's stock quantity unit.

best_before_date.name: Best-before date
best_before_date.description: Leave empty to use the product's default shelf life from Grocy (or 'never expires').

image.name: Photo of the best-before date
image.description: Optional. A camera snapshot or uploaded photo; the AI Task entity reads the best-before date. Ignored when a best-before date is given.

location_id.name: Location ID
location_id.description: Grocy location ID. Leave empty for the product's default location.

config_entry_id.name: Grocy instance
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when more than one Grocy AI entry is configured.

consume_stock.name: Consume stock
consume_stock.description: Books consumption in Grocy (stock -amount) by barcode or product ID.

barcode.name: Barcode
barcode.description: Barcode of the product (EAN/GTIN or a Grocy barcode). Use either barcode or product ID.

product_id.name: Product ID
product_id.description: Grocy product ID. Use either barcode or product ID.

amount.name: Amount
amount.description: Amount in the product's stock quantity unit.

spoiled.name: Spoiled
spoiled.description: Book as spoiled (thrown away) instead of consumed.

config_entry_id.name: Grocy instance
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when more than one Grocy AI entry is configured.

scan.name: Scan
scan.description: Convenience service for buttons and tablets: barcode + mode plus/minus.

barcode.name: Barcode
barcode.description: Barcode of the product (EAN/GTIN or a Grocy barcode). Use either barcode or product ID.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: plus = purchased (add stock), minus = used up (consume stock).

image.name: Photo of the best-before date
image.description: Optional. A camera snapshot or uploaded photo; the AI Task entity reads the best-before date. Ignored when a best-before date is given.

amount.name: Amount
amount.description: Amount in the product's stock quantity unit.

config_entry_id.name: Grocy instance
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when more than one Grocy AI entry is configured.

read_best_before.name: Read best-before date
read_best_before.description: Reads the best-before date from a photo via AI Task (no booking).

image.name: Photo
image.description: Camera snapshot or uploaded photo of the best-before date.

config_entry_id.name: Grocy instance
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when more than one Grocy AI entry is configured.

read_barcode.name: Read barcode
read_barcode.description: Reads the barcode number from a photo via AI Task (no booking). Only numbers with a valid check digit are returned.

image.name: Photo
image.description: Camera snapshot or uploaded photo of the barcode.

config_entry_id.name: Grocy instance
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when more than one Grocy AI entry is configured.

unknown_barcode.message: Barcode {barcode} is not known in Grocy.

unknown_product.message: Product {product_id} does not exist in Grocy.

not_loaded.message: Grocy AI is not set up or not loaded.

multiple_entries.message: More than one Grocy AI entry is configured – please choose one (config_entry_id).

entry_not_found.message: Grocy AI entry {entry_id} was not found.
